item.title: aadd
item.description:

item.title: rust anything
item.description:
Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
This various technologies project caught my attention for its practical approach to solving real developer problems. The codebase offers patterns worth studying for anyone working in this space.

item.title: bashkit

**The Problem** Applications that need to run user‑supplied shell scripts must isolate those scripts from the host process, the real file system, and the network.
